name: dev-agent
description: Native workflow entrypoint for the lean Dev Agent lifecycle: idea, spec, design, build, optional QA, optional ship.

actions.flow: Route to a lifecycle flow by name.
actions.role: Invoke a specialist role/persona by name.
actions.next: Recover the current project phase and next executable brief.
actions.check: Run an executable gate for the current project.

flows.name: spec
flows.skill: spec-driven-development with PRD and agent-contract sections when needed

flows.name: plan
flows.skill: task planning and autonomy review control

flows.name: build
flows.skill: incremental-implementation with micro-plan and proof-first checklist
flows.defaultGate: bin/dev-flow env-check <project> when host-dependent, then bin/dev-flow verify-phase <project> build, then bin/dev-flow check <project>

flows.name: qa
flows.skill: frontend-ui-engineering with optional acceptance, monkey, visual, and quality review
flows.defaultGate: bin/dev-flow qa-check <project> when QA is required

flows.name: code-simplify
flows.defaultGate: bin/dev-flow verify-phase <project> build, then bin/dev-flow check <project>

roles.name: code-reviewer
roles.bestFor: Five-axis code review before merge or ship.

roles.name: product-designer
roles.bestFor: UX, visual system, references, and screen acceptance.

roles.name: technical-steward
roles.bestFor: Independent technical quality sign-off, architecture challenge, evidence review, and final readiness.

roles.name: test-engineer
roles.bestFor: Test strategy, gaps, coverage, and verification evidence.

roles.name: ui-quality-reviewer
roles.bestFor: Acceptance QA, monkey testing, and visual comparison review.
